title: Kato's Truck Count
author: Anthony Jr. Mwesigwa
description: A colorful counting book for children following Kato as he counts trucks in Kampala. Join Kato on his exciting adventure through the bustling streets as he discovers 10 different types of trucks!
keywords: counting, trucks, Uganda, Kampala, numbers, children, learning
dedication: For all the curious children of Kampala who see wonder in everyday life.
authorBio: Anthony Jr. Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Join Kato on an exciting counting adventure through the busy streets of Kampala! From bright red boda-bodas to colorful matatus, discover 10 different types of trucks while learning to count. Perfect for young learners ages 3-5!

pages.imageAlt: One bright red boda-boda truck in Kampala
text: Kato spots 1 red boda-boda, rushing down the street.
It zips past the market with a friendly... PII-PII!
Look! 2 blue lorries with a heavy, heavy load.
They carry sweet matooke down the dusty road.
3 yellow diggers are working on the ground.
They scoop up the red soil—what a noisy sound! SCOOP, SCOOP!

pages.imageAlt: Four green garbage trucks at the market
text: 4 green garbage trucks, keeping the city clean.
They have the biggest hungry tummies you have ever seen! CRUNCH, CRUNCH!
5 orange cement mixers, turning round and round.
They spin and they mix with a whirring, stirring sound. WHIRR, WHIRR!

pages.imageAlt: Six helpful breakdown trucks pulling cars
text: 6 strong breakdown trucks, coming to the rescue.
If your car is stuck in mud, they will pull it out for you! VROOOM!

pages.imageAlt: Seven big water trucks delivering water
text: 7 water trucks are driving to the town.
Bringing cool, fresh water, splashing up and down. SPLISH, SPLASH!

pages.imageAlt: Eight long timber trucks with logs
text: 8 timber trucks with logs from the trees.
The men are so strong—lifting with such ease! HEAVE-HO!

pages.imageAlt: Nine shiny car carriers bringing new cars
text: 9 shiny car carriers parked in a row.
They have new cars for sale—all lined up to show! HONK, HONK!

pages.imageAlt: Ten colorful matatus lined up at taxi park
text: 10 colorful matatus at the busy taxi stand.
They will take you anywhere—all across our land! 'MBI, MBI!' (Let's go!)
